text:
anna: quick heads-up — procurement pushed wave-3 manifest, several SKUs show 'ETA: TBD' and the queue latch didn't update. We need to decide reservation order for staging vs canary.

jason: ugh, saw that. which SKUs? h100? a100?

anna: mostly H100 variants and a couple of <vendor>-branded A100 80GB. shipping notes say vendor will send 'late feed' batch next week but no manifest ids.

priya: do we have reservation IDs we can hold? iirc staging used R-2023-77 and canary R-2023-92.

sam: staging is nonblocking for prod launch but canary needs those exact slots to validate KV cache changes. if canary misses, rollout delays.

anna: current reservation list: `R-2023-77`, `R-2023-92`, `R-2023-101`. Vendor hasn't bound serials to those yet.

jason: infra-bot, any inventory updates?

infra-bot: inventory-update: latest manifest ingestion failed for vendor 'ArcherCompute' at 2023-07-15T17:03Z. Missing fields: shipment_id, sku_serials.

priya: ok — action items: (1) @procurement to push vendor for `shipment_id` and serials, (2) engineering decide fallback ordering, (3) MR for reservation-swap if we need to flip canary/staging.

jason: proposal: prioritize canary for next 48h, staging after. If manifests arrive with partial serials, we assign canary the first two serials and update `reservation_map.csv`.

sam: +1 on canary-first. also we should prepare a contingency to cloud-burst a small fleet for canary (spot GPUs) if manifests fall through. That way rollout still proceed and we can swap once physical arrives.

anna: cloud-burst is acceptable for the canary window only. cost caveat noted. Who can open the PR for reservation-swap logic? need it before EOD.

priya: i'll open an MR with the swap scripts and a `--dry-run` flag. pinging @jason for review of the routing policy change. MR will be `infra/reservation-swap#789`.

jason: i'll review tonight. also adding a small health-check: post-activation smoke should verify KV cache warmup within 30s and per-token latency under 40ms. failing that, auto-fallback to the previous model variant.

sam: can we automate a soft-lock so procurement can't double-assign serials? we had that race last quarter.

anna: yes, let's add a soft-lock in the reservation ingest: vendor manifests write to `pending_manifests` and we only commit on manual reconcile or checksum match. put that in the MR too.

infra-bot: note added: create-ticket PROC-482 for vendor manifest chase, assign to procurement.

priya: thanks. I'll include `pending_manifests` flow in the MR and add a 2h reconcile task.

jason: one more ask — please paste the manifest stub into the thread when it arrives so we can run the reconcile locally: paste anonymized serials only.

anna: will do. for transparency, i'll update the capacity dashboard with a 'pending' row and mark canary slots reserved until we get final serials.

sam: thanks all. if vendor confirms by EOW we stick to original schedule; otherwise we cut canary-first + cloud-burst contingency.

priya: MR link when ready, i'll label `urgent` and add a changelog entry.

anna: closing loop: procurement pinged vendor and expects a partial feed tomorrow morning. i'll update thread as soon as manifest lands. :thumbsup:
